1.mascotDialogue: It's insertion sort, just given leave to take big steps first. Shrink that gap enough times and it collapses right on down into ordinary insertion sort for the final, finest pass.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2's gap starts at n over 2 and halves every outer pass. Lines 6 through 8 are just insertion sort's inner loop, 'cept comparin' arr[j] to arr[j minus gap] instead of arr[j minus 1].

3.mascotDialogue: Watch these first comparisons skip clean across three spots at a time — that's a gap of 3 doin' long-distance fixin' 'fore the finer gap-of-1 pass even starts up.

4.mascotDialogue: This here's a sneaky kinda bug — the output's correct, but the algorithm quietly stopped bein' the algorithm it claims to be. Not every bug crashes — some just quietly throw away the whole reason you picked this approach.
